blocks.text: If you check out early for a flight or excursion, you may miss breakfast at the hotel. Ada Tours does not reimburse the cost of a missed breakfast.
Arrive at El Dorado Airport in Bogotá, where your English-speaking guide will meet you. Transfer to your five-star hotel and check in. The rest of the day is free to take a walk on your own or relax.
Panoramic view of Bogotá, Colombia, with high-rise buildings and a circular arena beside a green hillside
Bogotá from above, with city neighbourhoods and a circular arena near the mountains

After breakfast, meet your English-speaking guide in the hotel lobby and set out on a tour of Bogotá’s historic centre.

On the walk, you’ll see colonial churches, old streets, historic squares and monuments from the 17th to the 19th centuries. The tour shows how the capital has changed. Older neighbourhoods retain their churches and historic buildings, while newer areas have high-rises, cafés, restaurants and shops run by local designers. Along the way, your guide will share stories about Bogotá’s history and culture.

One of the main stops is the Gold Museum. Its collection of pre-Columbian objects includes gold masks, diadems, bracelets, ritual figurines and symbols of authority. Then take the funicular up Monserrate, a hill 3,200 m above sea level. At the top you’ll find views across Bogotá and the 17th-century San Vicente monastery.

Next, visit the museum of Colombian painter and sculptor Fernando Botero. Lunch at a restaurant is scheduled during the day. After the tour, transfer back to the hotel and relax.
